Thromboembolic disorders. Dextran 40 is only one of a va- riety of drugs that have been used for the prophylaxis of venous thromboembolism (p.1189) resulting from surgical operations such as hip replacement surgery. Dextran 40 may be used to pre- vent thromboembolic complications in some types of vascular surgery including carotid endarterectomy.1 1. Abir F, et al. Efficacy of dextran solutions in vascular surgery. Vasc Endovascular Surg 2004; 38: 483–91.
